implementation.name: Pong (Analogue Pocket, agg23)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 51 HDL source files (11 verilog, 40 vhdl). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not setname-derived -- this core ships no MRA file. It reimplements Atari's 1972 Pong, which MAME models as a TTL driver, giving machine_id pong, each checked against extract/machine.json. License: https://github.com/agg23/openfpga-pong/blob/master/LICENSE is the MIT License text, read verbatim -- hence MIT. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 51 source files (11 verilog, 40 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Core identity read from the openFPGA manifest dist/Cores/agg23.Pong/core.json in the repository, which declares core identifier agg23.Pong.
